why: Wiring cycle 1 (docs/v3/cycles/wiring-1.md, P2 wiring-1.13): the export-surface gate does not see the v3 shell or the primitives. `scripts/export-surface.mjs:38-43` excludes `./shell` because it "is an alias of the 2.x shell barrel the root re-exports", but `dist/shell/index.d.ts` now exports the v3 `AppShell`, `defineCommands`, `CommandPalette`, `toMenuTemplate` and `useWindowChrome`, which the root does not; `./ui/*` is a wildcard and has no shard. A symbol added to or dropped from either reaches npm without a snapshot diff.
what: The export-surface snapshot covers `./shell` and each `ui/<name>` module.
owns: packages/basalt-ui/scripts/check-budgets/** where it counts shards or public symbols
change: Drop the `./shell` exclusion and its stale reason; expand `./ui/*` to one shard per shipped primitive module (the list the package's `ui/` directory or the primitive manifest gives), so a new or removed primitive export is a snapshot diff. If the public-symbol budget counts these shards, raise its landed value in the same commit with the reason.
commits: fix: or chore: in packages/basalt-ui; the snapshot written by `export-surface --update`.
proof: make check; the export-surface test fails on an unrecorded `./shell` or `ui/*` export.
acceptance: An export added to `src/shell/index.ts` without `--update` fails the test
